actionbutton_guide:
📱 Action Button (iPhone 15 Pro and newer) — step by step:

STEP 1 — Get your link:
• Open the Mini App → Settings → "Voice add via Shortcuts".
• Turn the toggle on and tap Copy.

STEP 2 — Create the shortcut in the Shortcuts app:
1. Tap + (top right) → Add Action.
2. Add Record Audio: turn off "Show Recording".
3. Add Action again → Get Contents of URL.
4. Paste the copied link into the URL field.
5. Tap "Show More": Method = POST, Request Body = Form.
6. In the form add a field: name = audio, type = File, value = Recorded Audio.
7. Tap Done and name the shortcut QK NOTES.

STEP 3 — Bind it:
1. iPhone Settings → Action Button.
2. Scroll to Shortcut and pick QK NOTES.

Done! Pressing the Action Button records your voice and sends it to the bot.
backtap_guide:
📱 Back Tap (iPhone 8 and newer) — step by step:

STEP 1 and 2 are the same as for the Action Button:
• Copy the link in the Mini App → Settings → "Voice add via Shortcuts" → Copy.
• In the Shortcuts app create a QK NOTES shortcut: Record Audio → Get Contents of URL (Method POST, Request Body = Form, field audio = Recorded Audio).

STEP 3 — Bind it:
1. iPhone Settings → Accessibility → Touch.
2. Scroll down to Back Tap.
3. Pick Double Tap or Triple Tap.
4. In the shortcut list pick QK NOTES.

Done! Double (or triple) tap the back of your iPhone — your voice goes to the bot.
